message.content: {"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In the first quarter of 2027, Dubai will launch a digital platform called Safety Pulse for investors that shows a live colour-coded safety rating of buildings using AI and IoT.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,5,6,7]},{"claim":"The platform tracks fire alarm systems, firefighting equipment, gas, electrical, and lifts systems, and connects owners with maintenance companies and fire stations.","supported":true,"evidence":[7,8,9]},{"claim":"By 2027, the firefighting drone fleet Shaheen will increase from two to six units to fight fires in high-rise buildings.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,16,18]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"From November 23, the GDRFA Humanitarian Cases Section will operate at a new location in the Dubai International Airport free zone in Al Twar 2.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"The relocation is due to maintenance work at the Dubai Festival City office.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Customer service hours will be from 6:30 to 14:30, and on Fridays until 12:00, excluding official public holidays.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]},{"claim":"The relocation will not affect the quality and speed of services.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Дубай инвестирует 1,3 млрд дирхам в улучшение дорог у World Trade Centre","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"В Дубае ведутся два крупных дорожных проекта стоимостью более 1,3 млрд дирхам для снижения пробок и сокращения времени ожидания на перекрестке Trade Centre с 12 минут до 90 секунд","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Проекты включают замену кольца на регулируемый перекресток с пятью мостами и расширение улицы Al Mustaqbal","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Ожидается, что улучшения повысят пропускную способность и улучшат связь между деловыми районами","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Работы идут с опережением графика, а новые мосты уже сократили время поездок с 6 до 1 минуты на некоторых участках","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Открыт новый парк Ghadeer Al Tair площадью 9,600 м²","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"В Дубае открыт первый из 35 новых общественных парков, ориентированных на активный образ жизни и укрепление связей в сообществе","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,3,9,11]},{"claim":"Парк расположен так, чтобы жители могли дойти до него пешком за пять минут","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"В парке есть детские площадки, беговая дорожка, уличные тренажёры и скоро откроется многофункциональный зал для мероприятий","supported":true,"evidence":[6,7]},{"claim":"Проект поддерживает стратегию развития зелёных зон Дубая до 2040 года","supported":true,"evidence":[2,11]},{"claim":"Проект включает экологические меры, такие как использование переработанной воды и возобновляемой энергии","supported":true,"evidence":[13]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai is preparing to celebrate the 55th anniversary of the UAE's Union.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"From 26 November to 6 December, Dubai will host national, cultural, and entertainment events organized by Dubai Festivals and Retail Establishment.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The program includes concerts, a light show with 1600 drones, an air show, and family activities.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Main events will take place at iconic venues including Burj Khalifa, Dubai Frame, and City Walk.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3]},{"claim":"Discounts of up to 75% will be available in stores.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Special dishes will be available as part of the Flavours of the Union initiative.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"From January 1, 2027, taxi drivers in the UAE cannot refuse passengers without a valid reason.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,8,11,27]},{"claim":"Taxi drivers cannot charge more than the established fare.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,8,14,15,28]},{"claim":"The maximum number of passengers in a taxi is limited by the license: usually four for sedans and six for larger vehicles.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,8,18,19,27]},{"claim":"Taxi drivers must stop only at designated places.","supported":true,"evidence":[25,27]},{"claim":"Taxi drivers must comply with traffic rules.","supported":true,"evidence":[29,30]},{"claim":"Information about the maximum number of passengers and license number must be visible inside the taxi.","supported":true,"evidence":[21,22]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"В районе Карама в Дубае установлены камеры Parkin рядом с парковочными местами, предназначенными для People of Determination (PoD).","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,2]},{"claim":"Устройства помогают выявлять автомобили без разрешения, занимающие эти места.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,4,5,6,7]},{"claim":"Камеры используют технологию распознавания номеров и проверяют наличие действующих разрешений.","supported":true,"evidence":[5,6,7]},{"claim":"Нарушителям грозит штраф в размере 1000 дирхамов и ограничение времени парковки до четырёх часов.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Местные жители отмечают, что камеры помогут сохранить доступность парковочных мест для тех, кто в них действительно нуждается.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3,4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Ras Al Khaimah has launched a nationwide delivery service for vehicle number plates across all seven emirates of the UAE.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Motorists can receive their vehicle number plates at a location of their choice without visiting a collection centre.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Delivery requests can be made through the Ministry of Interior’s mobile application or the TAMM digital government services platform.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"To receive the delivery, motorists must present their Emirates ID.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,1]},{"claim":"Number plate installation in Ras Al Khaimah remains free of charge.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"В ОАЭ школьникам с диабетом разрешили пользоваться телефонами и брать перекусы на экзаменах","supported":true,"evidence":[0,2,3]},{"claim":"Министерство образования ОАЭ утвердило меры для поддержки учеников с диабетом","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Им разрешено использовать глюкометры и мобильные телефоны с датчиками сахара во время экзаменов","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3]},{"claim":"Им разрешено приносить воду и еду на экзамены","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Если уровень сахара нарушается, время экзамена приостанавливается","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"При необходимости допускается пересдача экзамена","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"В классе ученики могут проверять сахар и пить воду без ограничений","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Учителя должны уважать их приватность и не делать замечаний перед одноклассниками","supported":true,"evidence":[4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"For the next four days in the UAE, rain is expected according to the National Centre of Meteorology.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3]},{"claim":"Temperature on Thursday will drop to the high 20s Celsius.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,3]},{"claim":"Minimum temperature in some areas, such as Ras Al Khaimah, may reach 18°C.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,11]},{"claim":"Today, temperature in Dubai and Abu Dhabi will reach 33°C.","supported":true,"evidence":[5,11]},{"claim":"Today, temperature in Fujairah will be 29°C.","supported":true,"evidence":[6,11]},{"claim":"Wind and sea will be calm.","supported":true,"evidence":[9,10]},{"claim":"Fog is possible in western areas, and drivers are advised to be cautious.","supported":true,"evidence":[7,8]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Flights EY057 from Abu Dhabi to Brussels and EY058 from Brussels to Abu Dhabi on November 23 are delayed due to an air traffic controllers' strike in Brussels.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Passengers are advised to update their contact details via Etihad's Manage Booking service to receive notifications and to contact the airline for assistance.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"В Дубае представили новый подход к государственным услугам и виртуального помощника «Mira», который упрощает доступ к сервисам через один диалог.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,8,10,11,12]},{"claim":"Запуск прошёл в присутствии шейха Мохаммеда бин Рашида и других высокопоставленных лиц.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,8,9,10]},{"claim":"Первые услуги станут доступны в марте 2027 года.","supported":true,"evidence":[10]},{"claim":"«Mira» помогает пользователям описать свои потребности и завершить транзакции без сложных процедур.","supported":true,"evidence":[10,11,12]},{"claim":"Среди функций — обновление паспортов, управление контрактами и запись к врачу.","supported":true,"evidence":[14,15,16,17,20,21,22]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai Shopping Festival 2026-2027 will run from December 4, 2026 to January 17, 2027.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The festival will feature 1000 brands and 4000 stores.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The festival offers prizes worth over 20 million dirhams.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,14]},{"claim":"The festival program includes raffles, concerts, and entertainment.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,4]},{"claim":"Prizes include gold, cars, real estate, and cash.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,12]},{"claim":"Among the main prizes are a kilogram of gold, a Nissan Magnite car, and cash prizes up to 1 million dirhams.","supported":true,"evidence":[12,15]}]}

{"supported":false,"reason":"The post contains factual inaccuracies and omissions compared to the source. The post claims schools and universities in Dubai will be closed from December 2 to 6, but the source states Dubai private schools and higher education institutions are closed from December 2 to 4, with classes resuming December 7, giving five consecutive days off including the weekend. The post omits that private-sector employees get two paid public holidays on December 2 and 3, with December 4 a regular working day, and that federal employees have a five-day break from December 2 to 6. The post generalizes the festival dates and locations without specifying details. Therefore, not all claims are supported.","claims":[{"claim":"55-й День Союза ОАЭ пройдет с 2 по 6 декабря с праздничными мероприятиями.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,16,18,19]},{"claim":"Федеральные служащие получат пятидневный выходной с 2 по 6 декабря.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"Сотрудники частного сектора получат два оплачиваемых выходных дня.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"В Дубае школы и вузы будут закрыты с 2 по 6 декабря.","supported":false,"evidence":[10]},{"claim":"В разных эмиратах пройдут фестивали с дронами, фейерверками и культурными программами.","supported":true,"evidence":[16,18,19]},{"claim":"Министерство внутренних дел напомнило о правилах безопасности на дорогах и запрете несанкционированных автопарадов во время праздников.","supported":true,"evidence":[19]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In the UAE, first-term exams will begin on 25 November.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Students in Grades 3 to 12 in the UAE will start first-term exams on 25 November.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Exams will last until 11 December with a break for the National Day holiday.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Students in Grades 3 and 4 will take paper-based tests.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Students in Grades 5 to 12 will take paper-based or electronic tests depending on the subject.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Grade 12 students are required to bring laptops.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"Strict anti-cheating measures are introduced: mobile phones, smartwatches and other devices are prohibited.","supported":true,"evidence":[11]},{"claim":"Cheating practices such as exchanging answers and falsifying documents are prohibited.","supported":true,"evidence":[11]},{"claim":"For the first cheating offense, students receive zero in the subject and have conduct marks deducted.","supported":true,"evidence":[11]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In Dubai, from February to September 2026, 8,251 transactions were approved under the 'Self-License for Citizens’ Villas' initiative.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,6]},{"claim":"The time to obtain villa building permits was reduced by 37.5%, now taking five working days.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,6]},{"claim":"The initiative allows accredited engineering consulting offices to independently obtain building permits, simplifying and accelerating the process.","supported":true,"evidence":[5,11,13]},{"claim":"After implementing the post-investigation mechanism, 36 violations were detected and corrected.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,7]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In the UAE, Meta smart glasses with hands-free photo and video recording functions have become available.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The availability of these glasses raises privacy concerns in public places.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,9]},{"claim":"UAE legislation provides for liability for recording without consent, including fines up to 500,000 dirhams and imprisonment.","supported":true,"evidence":[14]},{"claim":"Experts warn about data leakage risks and the need for responsible use of the device.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4,5,7,15,17,18]},{"claim":"The owner must respect the rights of others and comply with security settings.","supported":true,"evidence":[17,18]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In Umm Al Quwain, fines will be introduced for trucks using prohibited roads.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"From December 1, 2026, truck drivers heading to Umm Al Thuoob Industrial Area will be fined 1000 dirhams and receive four black traffic points for using prohibited roads or restricted entrances.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"The entrance opposite Exit 103 on Highway 311 is closed to heavy vehicles.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Truck drivers must continue to Exit 110 and take a return route to the industrial area through a designated entrance to the Free Trade Zone.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Signs and cameras have been installed at the closed entrance to monitor compliance.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"В международном аэропорту Дубая (DXB) обновили мобильную сеть до 5G+, обеспечив пиковую скорость загрузки более 3 Гбит/с.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Улучшение направлено на повышение скорости интернета и пропускной способности сети в помещениях аэропорта, где большое число пассажиров создает нагрузку на связь.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Обновленная сеть поддержит не только мобильный интернет для пассажиров, но и цифровые операции аэропорта, способствуя внедрению новых технологий.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]},{"claim":"Скорость зависит от совместимости устройств и загруженности сети.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"flydubai увеличивает число рейсов в Бангкок до трёх в день","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"С 27 ноября flydubai запускает третий ежедневный рейс из Дубая в международный аэропорт Дон Мыанг в Бангкоке","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Это решение связано с высоким спросом на перелёты между двумя городами","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3]},{"claim":"Общее количество рейсов в Таиланд достигнет 35 в неделю, включая 21 рейс в Бангкок и 14 в Краби","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"Все рейсы будут отправляться из Терминала 3 аэропорта Дубая","supported":true,"evidence":[10]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Власти Дубая объявили о заключении контрактов на развитие Международного аэропорта Аль-Мактум на сумму около AED56,5 млрд.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,2,4,15]},{"claim":"Работы охватят пассажирские терминалы, транспортную инфраструктуру и электроснабжение.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,15]},{"claim":"Общий объем контрактов по проекту достигнет примерно AED80 млрд.","supported":true,"evidence":[13,15]},{"claim":"Строительство ведется на нескольких ключевых объектах, включая терминалы и подземные коммуникации, с участием около 14 тысяч рабочих.","supported":true,"evidence":[13,15]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Шейх Мохаммед бин Рашид ознакомился с ходом реализации проектов в рамках плана развития до 2040 года.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3,4,15]},{"claim":"Среди проектов — туристические и жилые объекты, инфраструктурные улучшения и создание условий для предпринимательства.","supported":true,"evidence":[13,14,15,16]},{"claim":"В числе проектов — гидроэлектростанция DEWA мощностью 250 МВт.","supported":true,"evidence":[17,18]},{"claim":"В числе проектов — туристический комплекс Hatta Beach.","supported":true,"evidence":[15]},{"claim":"В числе проектов — жилые кварталы Makan 1 и Makan 2.","supported":true,"evidence":[25,28]},{"claim":"Планируется сдать дома в конце декабря 2026 года.","supported":true,"evidence":[27]},{"claim":"Шейх подчеркнул важность сохранения культурного наследия и природной среды Хатты.","supported":true,"evidence":[23,24]},{"claim":"Шейх подчеркнул важность развития экономики и социальной сферы региона.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,5,8,9,12,13,24,25]}]}
